First,
expand the right-hand side terms $\sqf{\bias{\hth}}$ and $\var{\hth}$:

$$
\ba
\sqf{\bias{\hth}}
&= \sqf{\E{\hth} - \th} && \text{(by Definition @def-bias)} \\
&= \sqf{\E{\hth}} - 2\E{\hth}\th + \th^2 && \text{(by binomial expansion)}
\ea
$$

and

$$
\var{\hth} = \E{\hth^2} - \sqf{\E{\hth}} \quad \text{(by Definition @def-variance)}
$$

Adding these two components together yields:

$$
\ba
\sqf{\bias{\hth}} + \var{\hth}
&= \sqf{\E{\hth}} - 2\E{\hth}\th + \th^2 + \E{\hth^2} - \sqf{\E{\hth}} && \text{(by substitution)} \\
&= \E{\hth^2} - 2\E{\hth}\th + \th^2 && \text{(by cancelling $\sqf{\E{\hth}}$ terms)}
\ea
$$

Next,
expand the left-hand side $\mselr{\hth}$:

$$
\ba
\mselr{\hth} 
&= \E{\sqf{\erf{\hth}}} && \text{(by Definition @def-mse)} \\
&= \E{(\hth - \th)^2} && \text{(by Definition @def-estimation-error)} \\
&= \E{\hth^2 - 2\hth\th + \th^2} && \text{(by expanding the square)} \\
&= \E{\hth^2} - \E{2\hth\th} + \E{\th^2} && \text{(by linearity of expectation)} \\
&= \E{\hth^2} - 2\E{\hth}\th + \th^2 && \text{(since $\th$ is constant)}
\ea
$$

Since both $\mselr{\hth}$ and $\sqf{\bias{\hth}} + \var{\hth}$ equal $\E{\hth^2} - 2\E{\hth}\th + \th^2$,
the two sides are equal:

$$\mselr{\hth} = \sqf{\bias{\hth}} + \var{\hth}$$
